items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Well, I traveled with Ina for a year. I traveled with the band all over the country.

ctx.x: No, after Basie, when you're arranging for Glenn Miller, Artie Shaw, Ina Ray, what did you do?
Well, I traveled with Ina for a year. I traveled with the band all over the country.
